items.title: 2 pedestrians struck by vehicle in North York: police
items.summary: Two pedestrians are in hospital after they were struck by a vehicle in North York. Toronto police were called to Keele Street and Downsview Park Boulevard just before 3 p.m. for reports of a collision.

items.title: Downtown Eastside housing workers resist B.C. non-profit's facial recognition plans
items.summary: The union representing workers at a Downtown Eastside housing non-profit in Vancouver is resisting a plan to implement facial recognition technology for employees.

items.title: Thousands take to streets in Portugal, France and Spain over rising living costs
items.summary: Thousands of people demonstrated in Portugal and France on Saturday, calling for higher wages, affordable housing and action to tackle the rising cost of living. In Lisbon, workers marched despite heavy rain, while trade unions, Yellow Vest activists and youth groups gathered in Paris.
